request.description:
Basic liveness probe for the API process.

Role: none (public, no token required).

Success: 200 OK — { status: "ok", service: "uceconnect-backend", version, timestamp }.

Errors: none expected; a non-200 response indicates the process is down or unreachable.

Registers a new student account and sends a 6-digit verification code by email. Registration always creates a student account — there is no role field accepted by this endpoint.

Role: none (public).

Success: 201 Created — { message, user }.

Errors: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR-shaped body (message: "Validation error", errors: {field: [..]}) for schema violations (short name, non-institutional email, mismatched passwords, weak password); 400 EMAIL_ALREADY_REGISTERED if the email is already registered; 500 INTERNAL_ERROR.

Confirms the 6-digit code sent at registration and activates the account.

Role: none (public).

Success: 200 OK — { message }.

Errors: 404 CODE_NOT_FOUND; 400 CODE_ALREADY_USED; 400 CODE_EXPIRED; 400 INVALID_CODE; 500 INTERNAL_ERROR.

Re-sends a new verification code for an unverified account.

Role: none (public).

Success: 200 OK — result message.

Errors: 404 USER_NOT_FOUND; 400 ALREADY_VERIFIED; 500 INTERNAL_ERROR.

Authenticates a user and issues an access token (1h) and refresh token (7d).

Role: none (public).

Success: 200 OK — { accessToken, refreshToken, user: { id, firstName, lastName, email, role } }.

Errors: 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS (unknown email or wrong password); 403 EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED; 403 USER_DISABLED.

Returns the authenticated user profile including faculty/career names.

Role: any authenticated user.

Success: 200 OK — { user: { id, firstName, lastName, email, phone, faculty, career, avatarUrl } }.

Errors: 401 TOKEN_REQUIRED (missing token); 401 TOKEN_INVALID (expired/invalid token); 500 INTERNAL_ERROR.

Updates editable profile fields for the authenticated user. All fields are optional.

Role: any authenticated user.

Success: 200 OK — { message, user }.

Errors: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR (invalid phone format, faculty/career mismatch); 401 TOKEN_REQUIRED / TOKEN_INVALID; 500 INTERNAL_ERROR.

Uploads a new profile picture (multipart form-data) and stores it via Cloudinary.

Role: any authenticated user.

Success: 200 OK — { message, avatarUrl }.

Errors: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR (file missing or type not allowed); 401 TOKEN_REQUIRED / TOKEN_INVALID; 500 INTERNAL_ERROR.

Sends a 6-digit password reset code by email, valid for 5 minutes.

Role: none (public).

Success: 200 OK — { message }.

Errors: 404 USER_NOT_FOUND; 400 USER_DISABLED; 500 INTERNAL_ERROR.

Validates the password reset code and issues a short-lived (15m) resetToken JWT (purpose: reset_password) required by Reset Password.

Role: none (public).

Success: 200 OK — { message, resetToken }.

Errors: 404 CODE_NOT_FOUND; 400 CODE_ALREADY_USED; 400 CODE_EXPIRED; 400 INVALID_CODE.

Re-sends a new password reset code.

Role: none (public).

Success: 200 OK — result message.

Errors: 404 USER_NOT_FOUND; 400 USER_DISABLED; 500 INTERNAL_ERROR.

Sets a new password using the resetToken obtained from Verify Reset Code. The new password must differ from the current one and must include upper, lower, number and special character.

Role: none (public — auth is via resetToken, not access token).

Success: 200 OK — { message }.

Errors: 401 INVALID_RESET_TOKEN (invalid/expired JWT or wrong purpose); 404 USER_NOT_FOUND; 400 SAME_PASSWORD; 500 INTERNAL_ERROR.

Redirects (302) to the Microsoft OAuth consent screen. Must be opened in a browser, not run as a normal Postman request, since Postman follows redirects and cannot complete the interactive login.

Role: none (public).

Success: 302 redirect to Microsoft login.

Errors: 500 MICROSOFT_AUTH_ERROR.

Returns the full catalog of UCE faculties.

Role: any authenticated user.

Success: 200 OK — { data: [...] }.

Errors: 401 TOKEN_REQUIRED / TOKEN_INVALID; 500 INTERNAL_ERROR.

Returns careers belonging to the given faculty.

Role: any authenticated user.

Success: 200 OK — { data: [...] }.

Errors: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR (facultyId missing/invalid); 401 TOKEN_REQUIRED / TOKEN_INVALID.

Returns the Help & FAQ page content plus support contact email.

Role: any authenticated user.

Success: 200 OK — { pageTitle, pageDescription, supportEmail, items: [{ question, answer, order }] }.

Errors: 401 TOKEN_REQUIRED / TOKEN_INVALID; 500 INTERNAL_ERROR.

Returns application metadata (name, version, description, institution, contact, branding).

Role: any authenticated user.

Success: 200 OK — { applicationName, version, description, institution, contact: { email, website }, developedBy, copyright, logoUrl }.

Errors: 401 TOKEN_REQUIRED / TOKEN_INVALID; 500 INTERNAL_ERROR.

Creates an incident. Title (5-200 chars) and description (10-5000 chars) are required. The backend runs AI classification/duplicate-detection in the background (with a rule-based fallback) and notifies staff.

Role: student only.

Success: 201 Created — { message, incident: { ..., ticket: "INC-YYYY-XXXX", aiClassified, duplicateWarning, similarIncidents } }.

Errors: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR (schema violations); 403 INSUFFICIENT_ROLE (manager/admin); 401 TOKEN_REQUIRED / TOKEN_INVALID.

Given a draft title/description, returns similar existing incidents before submission (duplicate warning preview).

Role: student only.

Success: 200 OK — { data: [...] }.

Errors: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR; 403 INSUFFICIENT_ROLE; 401 TOKEN_REQUIRED / TOKEN_INVALID; 500 INTERNAL_ERROR.

Lists incidents. Students only ever see their own incidents (no pagination object); managers/admins see all incidents, paginated (default page=1, limit=5).

Role: any authenticated user (scope differs by role).

Success: 200 OK — { data: [...] } for students, or { data: [...], pagination: { page, limit, total } } for staff.

Errors: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR (bad query params); 401 TOKEN_REQUIRED / TOKEN_INVALID.

Same as List My Incidents, filtered to a single status. Valid values: open, in_progress, resolved, rejected, cancelled.

Role: any authenticated user.

Success: 200 OK — { data: [...] } (+ pagination for staff).

Errors: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR (invalid status enum); 401 TOKEN_REQUIRED / TOKEN_INVALID.

Same as List My Incidents with explicit pagination (staff only; students always get the full unpaginated list regardless of these params). limit is capped at 50.

Role: any authenticated user.

Success: 200 OK — { data: [...], pagination: { page, limit, total } } for staff.

Errors: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR; 401 TOKEN_REQUIRED / TOKEN_INVALID.

Returns full incident detail: the incident, its attachments, conversation (observations) count and status timeline. Managers/admins additionally receive internalNotes.

Role: any authenticated user; students may only view their own incident.

Success: 200 OK — { incident, attachments: [...], conversationCount, timeline: [...], internalNotes? }.

Errors: 404 INCIDENT_NOT_FOUND; 403 INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSION (student viewing another student's incident); 401 TOKEN_REQUIRED / TOKEN_INVALID.

Returns a reduced public view of an incident (used for duplicate-detection previews).

Role: any authenticated user; students may only view their own incident.

Success: 200 OK — { incident: { id, title, status, ... } }.

Errors: 404 INCIDENT_NOT_FOUND; 403 INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSION; 401 TOKEN_REQUIRED / TOKEN_INVALID.

Returns the conversation thread (observations/replies) for an incident.

Role: any authenticated user; students may only view their own incident.

Success: 200 OK — { observations: [...] }.

Errors: 404 INCIDENT_NOT_FOUND; 403 INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSION; 401 TOKEN_REQUIRED / TOKEN_INVALID.

Edits an incident's title/description/category while it is still open. All fields optional.

Role: student only, and only the owner.

Success: 200 OK — { message, incident }.

Errors: 404 INCIDENT_NOT_FOUND; 403 INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSION (not the owner); 400 BUSINESS_RULE_VIOLATION (status is not open); 403 INSUFFICIENT_ROLE (manager/admin); 401 TOKEN_REQUIRED / TOKEN_INVALID.

Cancels an open incident (status becomes cancelled, not rejected). Only the student owner can cancel, and only while open.

Role: student only, and only the owner.

Success: 200 OK — { message, incident } with incident.status === "cancelled".

Errors: 404 INCIDENT_NOT_FOUND; 403 INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSION; 400 BUSINESS_RULE_VIOLATION (status is not open); 401 TOKEN_REQUIRED / TOKEN_INVALID.

Uploads one or more files (image/document/video, size and type limits from Settings) attached to an incident, stored via Cloudinary.

Role: student (owner), manager or admin.

Success: 201 Created — { message, attachments: [...] }.

Errors: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR (no file, disallowed type, size exceeded); 404 INCIDENT_NOT_FOUND; 403 INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSION; 401 TOKEN_REQUIRED / TOKEN_INVALID.

Transitions an incident's status and records a note + history entry, notifying the reporting student. Allowed target values: in_progress, resolved, rejected (schema-level); actual transitions are also constrained by IncidentStatus rules (open -> in_progress/rejected/cancelled, in_progress -> resolved/rejected; resolved/rejected/cancelled are terminal).

Role: manager or admin.

Success: 200 OK — { message, incident } with incident.status === "in_progress".

Errors: 404 INCIDENT_NOT_FOUND; 400 INVALID_TRANSITION; 403 INSUFFICIENT_ROLE (student); 401 TOKEN_REQUIRED / TOKEN_INVALID.

Same endpoint as above, transitioning an in_progress incident to resolved (terminal state).

Role: manager or admin.

Success: 200 OK — { message, incident } with incident.status === "resolved".

Errors: 404 INCIDENT_NOT_FOUND; 400 INVALID_TRANSITION (e.g. not currently in_progress); 403 INSUFFICIENT_ROLE; 401 TOKEN_REQUIRED / TOKEN_INVALID.

Same endpoint as above, rejecting an incident (terminal state), e.g. from open or in_progress.

Role: manager or admin.

Success: 200 OK — { message, incident } with incident.status === "rejected".

Errors: 404 INCIDENT_NOT_FOUND; 400 INVALID_TRANSITION; 403 INSUFFICIENT_ROLE; 401 TOKEN_REQUIRED / TOKEN_INVALID.

Overrides the AI-assigned category for an incident with a manually chosen categoryId.

Role: manager or admin.

Success: 200 OK — { message, incident }.

Errors: 404 INCIDENT_NOT_FOUND; 400 VALIDATION_ERROR (categoryId does not exist); 403 INSUFFICIENT_ROLE; 401 TOKEN_REQUIRED / TOKEN_INVALID.

Adds a staff-only internal note (not visible to the student) to an incident.

Role: manager or admin.

Success: 201 Created — { message, note }.

Errors: 404 INCIDENT_NOT_FOUND; 400 VALIDATION_ERROR (empty/too long message); 403 INSUFFICIENT_ROLE; 401 TOKEN_REQUIRED / TOKEN_INVALID.

Lists notifications for the authenticated user, newest first, paginated.

Role: any authenticated user.

Success: 200 OK — { data: [...], pagination: { page, limit, total } }.

Errors: 401 TOKEN_REQUIRED / TOKEN_INVALID.

Same as List My Notifications, filtered to unread only.

Role: any authenticated user.

Success: 200 OK — { data: [...], pagination }.

Errors: 401 TOKEN_REQUIRED / TOKEN_INVALID.

Same as List My Notifications with explicit page/limit.

Role: any authenticated user.

Success: 200 OK — { data: [...], pagination: { page: 1, limit: 10, total } }.

Errors: 401 TOKEN_REQUIRED / TOKEN_INVALID.

Marks a single notification as read.

Role: any authenticated user, and only the notification's owner.

Success: 200 OK — { message }.

Errors: 404 NOTIFICATION_NOT_FOUND; 403 INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSION (not the owner); 401 TOKEN_REQUIRED / TOKEN_INVALID.

Returns aggregate incident metrics (counts by status, by day, etc.) for the given lookback window (days, default 30, max 90).

Role: manager or admin.

Success: 200 OK — metrics object.

Errors: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR (invalid days); 403 INSUFFICIENT_ROLE (student); 401 TOKEN_REQUIRED / TOKEN_INVALID; 500 INTERNAL_ERROR.

Lists all users, paginated (default limit 10, max 50).

Role: admin only.

Success: 200 OK — { data: [...], pagination: { page, limit, total } }.

Errors: 403 INSUFFICIENT_ROLE; 401 TOKEN_REQUIRED / TOKEN_INVALID; 500 INTERNAL_ERROR.

Same as List Users, filtered by role (student, manager or admin).

Role: admin only.

Success: 200 OK — { data: [...], pagination }.

Errors: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR (invalid role enum); 403 INSUFFICIENT_ROLE; 401 TOKEN_REQUIRED / TOKEN_INVALID.

Creates a manager or admin account directly (no self-registration flow) and emails a password-setup link. role must be one of student, manager, admin.

Role: admin only.

Success: 201 Created — { message, user }.

Errors: 400 EMAIL_ALREADY_REGISTERED; 400 INVALID_EMAIL_DOMAIN; 400 VALIDATION_ERROR; 403 INSUFFICIENT_ROLE; 401 TOKEN_REQUIRED / TOKEN_INVALID.

Updates a user's role and/or active status (enable/disable account). At least one of role/isActive is required.

Role: admin only.

Success: 200 OK — { message, user }.

Errors: 404 USER_NOT_FOUND; 400 VALIDATION_ERROR; 403 INSUFFICIENT_ROLE; 401 TOKEN_REQUIRED / TOKEN_INVALID.

Lists incident categories, optionally filtered by isActive.

Role: any authenticated user.

Success: 200 OK — { data: [...] }.

Errors: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR (invalid isActive); 401 TOKEN_REQUIRED / TOKEN_INVALID; 500 INTERNAL_ERROR.

Creates a new incident category.

Role: admin only.

Success: 201 Created — { message, category }.

Errors: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR (name already exists or schema violation); 403 INSUFFICIENT_ROLE; 401 TOKEN_REQUIRED / TOKEN_INVALID.

Updates a category's name, description and/or active flag. At least one field is required.

Role: admin only.

Success: 200 OK — { message, category }.

Errors: 404 CATEGORY_NOT_FOUND; 400 VALIDATION_ERROR (duplicate name or schema violation); 403 INSUFFICIENT_ROLE; 401 TOKEN_REQUIRED / TOKEN_INVALID.

Returns the current global application settings (branding, upload limits/allowed types, contact info).

Role: any authenticated user.

Success: 200 OK — settings object.

Errors: 401 TOKEN_REQUIRED / TOKEN_INVALID; 500 INTERNAL_ERROR.

Updates one or more global settings fields (application name, contact email, upload limits, allowed MIME types). At least one field is required.

Role: admin only.

Success: 200 OK — { message, settings }.

Errors: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR; 403 INSUFFICIENT_ROLE; 401 TOKEN_REQUIRED / TOKEN_INVALID; 500 INTERNAL_ERROR.

Uploads a new application logo image, stored via Cloudinary.

Role: admin only.

Success: 200 OK — { message, logoUrl }.

Errors: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR (file missing); 403 INSUFFICIENT_ROLE; 401 TOKEN_REQUIRED / TOKEN_INVALID; 500 INTERNAL_ERROR.

Creates a new Help/FAQ entry.

Role: admin only.

Success: 201 Created — { message, item }.

Errors: 403 INSUFFICIENT_ROLE; 401 TOKEN_REQUIRED / TOKEN_INVALID; 500 INTERNAL_ERROR.

Updates an existing FAQ entry. At least one of question/answer/order is required.

Role: admin only.

Success: 200 OK — { message, item }.

Errors: 404 FAQ_ITEM_NOT_FOUND; 403 INSUFFICIENT_ROLE; 401 TOKEN_REQUIRED / TOKEN_INVALID; 500 INTERNAL_ERROR.

Deletes a FAQ entry.

Role: admin only.

Success: 200 OK — result message.

Errors: 404 FAQ_ITEM_NOT_FOUND; 403 INSUFFICIENT_ROLE; 401 TOKEN_REQUIRED / TOKEN_INVALID; 500 INTERNAL_ERROR.

Returns a monthly incident summary: counts by status, category breakdown and an AI-generated (with rule-based fallback) narrative summary. NOTE: the API takes a single "month" query param in YYYY-MM format — it does not accept separate year/month params. Omitting month defaults to the current month.

Role: admin only.

Success: 200 OK — { month, metrics, categoryBreakdown, summaryText }.

Errors: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR (month not in YYYY-MM format); 403 INSUFFICIENT_ROLE; 401 TOKEN_REQUIRED / TOKEN_INVALID; 500 INTERNAL_ERROR.

Same data as Get Monthly Report Summary, rendered and returned as a downloadable PDF file. NOTE: uses the single "month" (YYYY-MM) query param, not year/month.

Role: admin only.

Success: 200 OK — binary application/pdf body with Content-Disposition attachment.

Errors: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR; 403 INSUFFICIENT_ROLE; 401 TOKEN_REQUIRED / TOKEN_INVALID; 500 INTERNAL_ERROR.

Same data as Get Monthly Report Summary, rendered and returned as a downloadable .xlsx file. NOTE: uses the single "month" (YYYY-MM) query param, not year/month.

Role: admin only.

Success: 200 OK — binary spreadsheet body with Content-Disposition attachment.

Errors: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR; 403 INSUFFICIENT_ROLE; 401 TOKEN_REQUIRED / TOKEN_INVALID; 500 INTERNAL_ERROR.
